stage0005_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Hey, it's $$甲児$$ and the others!」

stage0005_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$甲児$$
「Hey, $$ワッ太$$, $$正太郎$$!
　Out hiking with your girlfriends?」

stage0005_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$かおる$$
「Some of you I haven't met yet.
　I'm $$滝かおる$$, $$ワッ太$$'s classmate.」

stage0005_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$マッキー$$
「I'm $$敷島牧子$$.
　Everyone just calls me $$マッキー$$.」

stage0005_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$マッキー$$'s dad is the famous Dr. $$敷島$$, huh.」

stage0005_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$アルト$$
「So her folks approve of her and $$正太郎$$, then?」

stage0005_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$マッキー$$
「Stop it...! It's not like that!」

stage0005_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ボス$$
「Still in grade school, and he's got a girl...」

stage0005_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ヌケ$$
「$$ボス$$... it's kind of sad...」

stage0005_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ムチャ$$
「Forget conquering Japan's students...
　we should've enjoyed our youth more...」

stage0005_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$沙慈$$
「You're all just the same as ever.」

stage0005_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$沙慈$$! Hey, it's really you, $$沙慈$$!」

stage0005_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「That's $$沙慈・クロスロード$$.
　We fought together in 《$$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$》.」

stage0005_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$n
「Will you invite him to the Defense Force too?」

stage0005_03:r_5cd353758cfe474d.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「No, not likely.
　$$沙慈$$ just got swept up in things
　and ended up fighting almost by accident.」

stage0005_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Besides, more than anything,
　he's chasing his own dream now.」

stage0005_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$甲児$$
「So why are you here, anyway?
　How's $$ルイス$$ doing?
　Still studying aerospace engineering?」

stage0005_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$沙慈$$
「I'll answer in order.
　After the $$再世戦争$$, I went back
　to 《$$アッシュフォード学園$$》...」

stage0005_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$沙慈$$
「After that, I transferred to Anaheim's
　technical college for hands-on training.」

stage0005_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$さやか$$
「Anaheim... you mean
　the one tied to Anaheim Electronics?」

stage0005_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$沙慈$$
「That's right.
　The main campus is in space, but I'm at
　the branch here in $$第２新東京市$$.」

stage0005_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$沙慈$$
「And $$ルイス$$ came to Tokyo too,
　to get treatment.」

stage0005_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$さやか$$
「Is she still... not doing well?」

stage0005_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$沙慈$$
「She's gotten a lot better.
　But she still gets headaches sometimes.」

stage0005_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「...These folks friends of yours, $$沙慈$$?」

stage0005_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$沙慈$$
「Friends from before I came to Anaheim.」

stage0005_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$沙慈$$
「Let me introduce you to $$甲児$$ and the others.
　They're my classmates at Anaheim...
　Though I'm older than the rest of them.」

stage0005_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「I'm $$タクヤ・イレイ$$.
　Nice to meet you.」

stage0005_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$ミコット$$
「I'm $$ミコット・バーチ$$.
　I'm at Anaheim's tech college too, with $$沙慈$$.」

stage0005_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$バナージ$$
「I'm $$バナージ・リンクス$$.」

stage0005_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「You're so stiff, $$バナージ$$.
　You nervous or something?」

stage0005_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$沙慈$$
「$$バナージ$$ and the others came from the
　colony Industrial 7 to $$第２新東京市$$ on a
　short exchange. Natural gravity's new to them.」

stage0005_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$ミコット$$
「But it's nice, all this natural greenery.
　I'm glad we came on this outing.」

stage0005_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I guess so.
　Everyone in my class says 《$$ふもふもランド$$》
　would've been better, though.」

stage0005_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「What's this $$ふもふもランド$$ place?」

stage0005_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$かおる$$
「It's an amusement park at the edge of $$第２新東京市$$.」

stage0005_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$マッキー$$
「Their mascot, $$ボン太くん#robot$$,
　is secretly getting really popular lately.」

stage0005_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ミコット$$
「Oh, wow...!
　Let's go while we're on exchange, $$バナージ$$.」

stage0005_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Oh, Kabuto!
　Have you seen Sagara!?」

stage0005_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$アルト$$
「Did he... go and do something again?」

stage0005_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$恭子$$
「Yeah...
　He keeps hacking at every bush he finds
　with a machete. The little kids are scared.」

stage0005_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$かなめ$$
「When I told him to stop,
　he said any bush an enemy might hide in
　needs to be dealt with immediately...」

stage0005_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$$かなめ$$
「$l!
　You're supposed to watch Sagara!」

stage0005_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$恭子$$
「When Kana got mad at him,
　Sagara said he'd scout the route ahead
　and went off on his own.」

stage0005_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But if we just let him run wild like that,
　it'll only make things worse!」

stage0005_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$恵理$$
「So, Chidori?
　Have you found Sagara?」

stage0005_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$かなめ$$
「He doesn't seem to be over here.」

stage0005_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$スズネ$$
「What should we do, Miss Kagurazaka?」

stage0005_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$恵理$$
「This is a problem...
　We can't just leave him be, but
　I still have the class to watch over...」

stage0005_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Understood.
　I'll take responsibility and find Sagara.」

stage0005_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$スズネ$$
「It's fine, Chidori.
　I'll be sure to bring some help.」

stage0005_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$スズネ$$
「So, boys, I'll need your help.」

stage0005_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ボス$$
「That guy...! They ran off to dodge the hassle!」

stage0005_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Sorry, $$正太郎$$.
　We dragged you into our situation.」

stage0005_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$正太郎$$
「No, please don't worry about it.」

stage0005_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$正太郎$$'s a boy investigator for $$ＩＣＰＯ$$.
　Chasing down suspects is right up his alley.」

stage0005_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Heh... so Sagara's the suspect now.」

stage0005_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I've seen this on the news!
　You're the pilot of $$鉄人$$ No. 28!」

stage0005_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But if you two know $$正太郎$$ like that,
　just who are you, Kabuto, Saotome...?」

stage0005_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I get it.
　I won't ask any further.」

stage0005_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Everyone's got a past of some kind.
　Now that you've reformed, why pry into it?」

stage0005_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$ミシェル$$
（Wait, does she maybe think
　we've been arrested by $$正太郎$$ before?）

stage0005_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$アルト$$
（Still better than her learning who we really are...）

stage0005_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「But $$かなめ$$'s pretty softhearted, huh.
　Joining the hunt for $$宗介$$ and all.」

stage0005_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I may not look it, but I'm class rep.
　And besides...」

stage0005_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Anyway, $l ran off from watch duty,
　and Sagara needs a good talking-to too!」

stage0005_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$宗介$$
「What's wrong, Chidori?
　Shouting like that all of a sudden...」

stage0005_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Anyone would jump if you popped out of a
　bush dressed like that all of a sudden!!」

stage0005_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$宗介$$
「It is a ghillie suit for camouflage.
　Essential equipment in the field.」

stage0005_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Sagara, I get how dedicated you are, so
　why don't you rejoin the group now?」

stage0005_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$宗介$$
「No. My mission is not yet complete.
　Therefore, I will continue the operation.」

stage0005_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's exactly what I mean by a nuisance...」

stage0005_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$宗介$$
「Whatever you say, this is my mission.」

stage0005_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Kabuto, Saotome!
　Hurry up and catch him already!」

stage0005_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$$アルト$$
「His gear's made for pushing through brush!
　He'll get away at this rate!」

stage0005_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$正太郎$$!
　Shoot him with the 《$$リゴールガン$$》!」

stage0005_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Even so, that's a bit much...!」

stage0005_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$甲児$$
「This is exactly when we need $n's power...!」

stage0005_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ボス$$
「That damn guy!
　Where'd they run off to at a time like this!?」

stage0005_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$宗介$$
「Shake the pursuit, resume mission at once...」

stage0005_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「$$宗介$$'s strung up in a tree!」

stage0005_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$甲児$$
「That trap...!
　Don't tell me you set that up?」

stage0005_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$n
「Read $$宗介$$'s movements right,
　and rigging something like this isn't hard.」

stage0005_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$アルト$$
「Even so, to build something like that
　in so little time...」

stage0005_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$n
「That's not the only trap I set.
　There's a drag snare and a spring trigger too.」

stage0005_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Setting all that without $$宗介$$ noticing...」

stage0005_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Method aside,
　nice work this time, $l.」

stage0005_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$n
「I got tired of Chidori
　nagging me nonstop.」

stage0005_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Well, now that that's settled,
　let's get Sagara down and rejoin the others.」

stage0005_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Oh... I must've caught it on something.」

stage0005_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$かなめ$$
「What do we do...
　Does anyone have a band-aid?」

stage0005_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$n
「...Use this.
　Press it to the wound, it'll stop the bleeding.」

stage0005_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$n
「Yarrow leaf... common yarrow.
　Best thing there is for stopping blood.」

stage0005_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Not just traps, but knowing about
　wild plants too? That's amazing.」

stage0005_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I take it back.
　Cool as you seem, you're tough outdoors.」

stage0005_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Doesn't that mean someone out hiking
　just got caught in a trap!」

stage0005_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
Branch Member
「Damn it! What is this!?」

stage0005_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Wearing a mask out here,
　that's blatantly suspicious!」

stage0005_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$甲児$$
「So it's those guys who got caught
　in $n's trap!」

stage0005_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
Branch Member
「What's going on here!?
　Why are there traps set up like this!?」

stage0005_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
Branch Member
「$$金田正太郎$$, damn you!
　At least one of you had better go down with me!」

stage0005_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$宗介$$
「You're not hurt, are you... Chidori?」

stage0005_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's reckless!
　Cutting a rope with a knife to escape a trap!」

stage0005_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$宗介$$
「But I was... the closest to your spot...」

stage0005_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Everyone, please evacuate right away!
　The Branch Members have deployed a robot!」

stage0005_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I'm sorry, Miss Kagurazaka.
　After I found Sagara, I evacuated with everyone.
　No one is hurt.」

stage0005_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$アルト$$
「Well, thanks to Miss $$スズネ$$ covering for us,
　we got away with it again.」

stage0005_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$甲児$$
「But man, with things turning out like this,
　wouldn't it be easier to just tell them who we are?」

stage0005_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$n
「Everyone at school is living in peace.
　It's better if they stay out of the fighting.」

stage0005_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$宗介$$ probably thinks the same way,
　which is why he keeps stringing her along with bad excuses.」

stage0005_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I won't get mad, so won't you tell me
　what's going on with you?」

stage0005_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$宗介$$
「Going on? I don't know what you mean...」

stage0005_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Fine, have it your way.
　Then can I ask the transfer student a question, as class rep?」

stage0005_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You lived abroad a long time, right?
　Was it like this at your old school too?」

stage0005_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$宗介$$
「That's right.
　Every day was peaceful and uneventful.」

stage0005_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$かなめ$$
「But you must be lonely, apart from your friends?」

stage0005_03:r_9dc59affd40f32fc.text:
$$宗介$$
「No... we keep in touch by phone and letter,
　so I wouldn't say we're strictly apart.」

stage0005_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$$宗介$$
「And some of them, like Saotome and $$ミシェル$$,
　I've gotten to see again.」

stage0005_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I see...
　Then what about a girlfriend?」

stage0005_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$かなめ$$
「A girlfriend, a sweetheart... that sort of thing!」

stage0005_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$宗介$$
「I have no acquaintance of that sort.」

stage0005_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$宗介$$
「A colleague... no, a friend once told me
　that no woman in the depths of the tundra would ever
　be my girlfriend, but I don't quite follow him.」

stage0005_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Ahaha! Hahahahaha!
　That friend of yours is a riot!」

stage0005_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Yeah.
　I mean, come on, Sagara... you're weird!」

stage0005_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Weird, seriously weird!
　Hehehe... but hey, maybe that's a rare trait.
　You might find a nice girl who gets it.」

stage0005_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$宗介$$
「A nice girl...
　I see, I'll keep that in mind.
　You're a nice girl.」

stage0005_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$かなめ$$
「N-no...
　Don't you dare take that seriously...!」

stage0005_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$宗介$$
「I see...
　Then I'll forget it.」

stage0005_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You really are weird! Heh, hehehe, hehehehehe!
　You're weird, so weird! Definitely weird!
　Hehehehehe, ahahahaha!」

stage0005_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Thanks, Sagara.
　You really helped me out today.」

stage0005_03:r_7980fd37141d88d0.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Not just today.
　That time the Mechanical Beast showed up, too.」

stage0005_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I'm sorry...
　I kept meaning to thank you,
　but I couldn't bring myself to say it until now...」

stage0005_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$かなめ$$
「I... might have misjudged you...
　You're...」

stage0005_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$恭子$$
「This is bad, Kana!
　$$小野Ｄ$$ and the others fell into a pit!」

stage0005_03:r_0149e3a5f2e5ef78.text:
$$恭子$$
「It was hidden so well,
　about ten of them fell in all at once!」

stage0005_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$宗介$$
「$n isn't the only one
　who can set up traps.」

stage0005_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$宗介$$
「Just in case, I set traps around
　the area where everyone evacuated to as well.」

stage0005_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$宗介$$
「Thorough preparation is the greatest
　advantage when repelling an attacker...」

stage0005_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Wh... what kind of person are you!!」

stage0005_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$宗介$$
「$n is right.
　If you, the class rep and our commander, lose your composure,
　it will put the whole class at risk...」

stage0005_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That's it, I've decided!
　Next month's field trip duty...!」

stage0005_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$かなめ$$
「You and your merry band of friends
　are all on trash duty!」

stage0005_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$n
（Cut it out, $$アルト$$...
　You can't win an argument with her.）

stage0005_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$かなめ$$
「If you've got time to dig pits,
　do something about the trash pits instead!」

stage0005_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$かなめ$$
「This is the class rep's final decision!」

stage0005_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$n
「Guess it always ends up this way...」

stage0005_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「...Today was a real disaster, huh, $$沙慈$$.」

stage0005_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$沙慈$$
「Yeah.
　But I'm glad everyone's safe.」

stage0005_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$ミコット$$
「I... kind of reconsidered my opinion of you, $$沙慈$$.
　Staying calm and acting rationally,
　even in a moment like that.」

stage0005_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$沙慈$$
「I'm just a little older than the rest of you.
　That much is nothing...」

stage0005_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$沙慈$$
（$$甲児$$ and $$アルト$$ and the others are fighting for peace...
　I have to do my best not to fall behind them...）

stage0005_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Man, I never thought I'd get to see the newest TMS,
　the $$リゼル$$, in actual combat.」

stage0005_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Word is that thing's still in evaluation testing.」

stage0005_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$沙慈$$
「You really know your stuff, $$タクヤ$$.」

stage0005_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「Of course I do.
　My dream's to become a test pilot
　or mechanic at Anaheim someday.」

stage0005_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ミコット$$
「$$バナージ$$, are you tired?」

stage0005_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$バナージ$$
（That strange feeling I had while evacuating...
　What in the world was that...）

stage0005_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$バナージ$$
（It was like someone was calling out to me...）

stage0005_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Oh, Miss $$スズネ$$... Good work on your first sortie.」

stage0005_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Whatever is the matter?
　You seem rather cross. Was $n rude
　to you again?」

stage0005_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Mr. $$ＡＧ$$!
　What is with that outfit!?」

stage0005_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$スズネ$$
「The combat suit from when I boarded the $$ジェニオン$$!」

stage0005_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, that one.
　That is a manifestation of the heart
　of the pilot who boards it.」

stage0005_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes.
　So, $n, wanting to grow stronger,
　ended up with that combat-oriented style.」

stage0005_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Of course, whatever the style,
　a protective skin or exoskeleton keeps
　the pilot perfectly safe.」

stage0005_03:r_5d8b67b5bd8ce190.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Incidentally, I have also taken your
　glasses into safekeeping for the time being.」

stage0005_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I believe it should be no trouble, as I warp the space
　in front of your eyes to serve as lenses.」

stage0005_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...The human heart is a complicated thing,
　if I may say so myself,
　it really is.」

stage0005_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even a young lady who seems pure on the surface
　can, underneath it all, sometimes be a mass of
　desire... a bloodthirsty beast.」

stage0005_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So then, Miss $$スズネ$$,
　just what sort of suit did you end up with?」

stage0005_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「N-no... it's nothing.
　I-I was just... a little startled, that's all...」

stage0005_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see.
　Well then, we hope for your continued patronage
　of $$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation going forward.」

stage0005_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, let's get going today too... business, business!」
